from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
import os
REPO = 'AbBibench/Antibody_Binding_Benchmark_Dataset'

# Download ALL binding affinity CSVs
csv_files = [
    'binding_affinity/1mhp_LC_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/1mlc_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/1n8z_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/2fjg_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/3gbn_h1_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/3gbn_h9_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/4d5_her2_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/4fqi_h1_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/4fqi_h3_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/5a12_ang2_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/aayl49_ML_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/aayl49_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/aayl50_LC_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/aayl51_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/aayl52_LC_benchmarking_data.csv',
    'binding_affinity/g6_LC_benchmarking_data.csv',
]
for f in csv_files:
    local = hf_hub_download(repo_id=REPO, filename=f, repo_type='dataset', local_dir='/data')
    print(f'Downloaded {f} -> {local}')

# Download ALL PDB structures
pdb_files = [
    'complex_structure/1mhp.pdb',
    'complex_structure/1mhp_hla.pdb',
    'complex_structure/1mlc_bae.pdb',
    'complex_structure/1n8z_bac.pdb',
    'complex_structure/2fjg_hlv.pdb',
    'complex_structure/3gbn_hlab.pdb',
    'complex_structure/4fqi_hlab.pdb',
    'complex_structure/4zff_hld.pdb',
    'complex_structure/4zfg_hla.pdb',
    'complex_structure/AAYL49_bca.pdb',
    'complex_structure/AAYL50_bca.pdb',
    'complex_structure/AAYL51_bca.pdb',
    'complex_structure/AAYL52_bca.pdb',
]
for f in pdb_files:
    local = hf_hub_download(repo_id=REPO, filename=f, repo_type='dataset', local_dir='/data')
    print(f'Downloaded {f} -> {local}')

# Download metadata
local = hf_hub_download(repo_id=REPO, filename='metadata.json', repo_type='dataset', local_dir='/data')
print(f'Downloaded metadata.json -> {local}')
print('All AbBiBench data downloaded.')
"
